comments.quote: 民宿老闆和老闆娘很熱情，可以唱卡拉OK，可以游泳，可以搓麻將，早飯白粥玉米饅頭雞蛋油條和各類小菜，停車方便，離龍鱗壩很近。附近的田園餐廳性價比高，味道也不錯，推薦。
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: The couple who run it are welcoming, and there is karaoke, a pool and mahjong. Breakfast is congee, corn, steamed buns, eggs, youtiao and various pickles. Parking is easy and the Longlin weir is close. The countryside restaurant nearby is good value and the food is decent.
